services.desc: Applicant must be able to perform an intermediate system without cueing/ spotting. We are looking for movement coming from the powerhouse/ proper engagement and the potential to perform advanced work. “In the body!” Amelia has been training at Pilates Body Shaping since joining Charlotte Ballet in 2015. While Pilates is Amelia’s preferred method of cross training, she truly believes Pilates is for everyone! She finds creativity in the ability to tailor her lessons to an individual’s needs and loves seeing growth in her clients.
